title: Nine Lines for a Roof
subtitle: 公益呼吁 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 呼吁与吸引力（社会服务与人际沟通·公益与号召）
meta: 主题语境：呼吁与吸引力（社会服务与人际沟通·公益与号召）　|　核心词汇：appeal　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 appeal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 my mother wrote ① an appeal for a roof, nine lines of it, and posted it to everybody she had ever worked with. There was ② appeal in her voice when she read it aloud, and my father said that was the part that worked; an appeal, she said, is a beg that has been taught to stand up straight. She posted nine copies on the Monday and said the shame came on the Wednesday.

The ③ appeal raised nine hundred pounds, which was the roof and half the windows, and she said the half was the better part. Every ④ appeal she ever wrote went out on a Tuesday, because Tuesday was the day the post was collected twice; an appeal, my father said, is one part need and nine parts timing.

My grandfather thought ⑤ appeal meant the other thing, the kind a thing has when you want it, and he said the roof had none. The  appeal, meaning the request and not the charm, is the only writing anybody in that house ever did on purpose; an appeal, my mother said, is a letter that admits it wants something, and my grandmother said that was the truest thing anybody said that year.

By 1981 the ⑥ appeal committee had nine members and one typewriter, and they met on the same Tuesday for four years. The ⑦ appeal went to court in 1983, a different appeal entirely, my father said, and the only one where nobody writes a letter, and it lost, and the roof was paid for out of the windows money. My father said that was the only lawsuit anybody in that house ever enjoyed.

The ⑧ appeal I remember is the nine lines she wrote in 1979, which nobody kept a copy of. An  appeal, she said in 1988, is the only thing you can send to a stranger that asks for money and gives them back their own good opinion; every appeal, she said, is a compliment wearing a bad coat.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 呼吁；请求（一次具体的募捐呼吁）
B. n. 感染力；动人之处
C. n. 吸引力；让人想要的东西
E. n. 上诉（法律意义）
F. 固定搭配：an appeal for something 为某事发出的呼吁
G. n. 呼吁（抽象总称；泛指这类请求）
H. n. 呼吁信；募捐信（指写出来的那封信）

items.q: The appeal raised nine hundred pounds
The appeal went to court in 1983

answers.why: an appeal for something 意为“为某事发出的呼吁”，1979 年母亲为修屋顶写了九行字的募捐呼吁。
appeal 意为“感染力、动人之处”，她把信念出来时，声音里有一种感染力。
appeal 意为“一次具体的募捐呼吁”，这次呼吁筹到九百镑，修了屋顶和一半窗户。
appeal 为抽象总称，泛指“呼吁这类请求”，她写的每一次呼吁都是星期二寄出的。
appeal 意为“吸引力”，祖父以为这个词指另一种东西：一件东西让人想要时具有的吸引力。
appeal 作定语，意为“募捐呼吁的”，到 1981 年募捐委员会有九个成员和一台打字机。
appeal 意为“上诉”，1983 年那次上诉完全不同，是唯一不需要写信的一种，结果败诉了。
appeal 意为“呼吁信、募捐信”，我记得的是 1979 年她写的那九行字，谁也没留底稿。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年母亲为修屋顶写了一封呼吁信，只有九行，寄给了所有和她共过事的人。（an appeal for）
她把信念出来的时候，声音里有一种感染力，父亲说起作用的就是这个。（appeal）
这次呼吁筹到九百镑，修了屋顶和一半窗户，她说那半边窗户才是最好的部分。（appeal）
她写的每一次呼吁都是星期二寄出的，因为星期二邮件收两次。（appeal）
祖父以为 appeal 指的是另一种东西：一件东西让人想要时具有的吸引力。（appeal）
1983 年那次上诉完全不同，那是唯一一种不用写信的，结果败诉了。（appeal）

There was appeal in her voice when she read it aloud, and my father said that was the part that worked.
The appeal raised nine hundred pounds, which was the roof and half the windows, and she said the half was the better part.
Every appeal she ever wrote went out on a Tuesday, because Tuesday was the day the post was collected twice.
My grandfather thought appeal meant the other thing, the kind a thing has when you want it.
The appeal went to court in 1983, a different appeal entirely, and the only one where nobody writes a letter, and it lost.
